| 有兼容客户端和设置服务的 DSH Web | 加载需要 | 显示设置卡和任务表 | 可能缺少入口或连接 |

| 运行中的浏览器页面 | 到期触发需要 | 周期检查并接入真实运行 | 关闭期间无触发，恢复后可能补跑 |

[Q04](#research-q04) 建议从单标签手动只读任务开始，确认实际工作区和会话输出再收尾。需要准确后台调度或结果无法回读时，继续用原有会话和调度工具。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 重复执行 | 任务卡驱动实际会话并记录执行 | 人工操作时间变化 |
| 过程回查 | 可以查看运行记录与会话 | 成功状态是否等于合格产物 |

控制器协调任务记录、存储、执行和浏览器调度。重载可重新读取可用会话，历史失败仍可被归为成功，重要任务须独立确认产物。
[Q01](#research-q01) 显示，卡片保存提示并能真实调用 DSH 会话，使重复任务和会话回读可以从同一位置发起。
[Q02](#research-q02) 显示，重载时历史缺失仍可能标为成功；[Q03](#research-q03) 的定时由浏览器执行，多个标签页之间没有原子认领。
[Q04](#research-q04) 提出用明确目标与宿主执行回执校验结案，以共享执行键对照测试重复触发。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 相对看板和手工新会话是宿主接线增量，新颖取小幅；用实际会话和执行 ID 让卡片对应后台过程是实质机制。浏览器本地账本与宿主执行分层可迁到有类似接口的应用，但 [Q02](#research-q02) 的宿主回执需重新核对。把复制和回读压到一张卡，简化受条件限制。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 面向重复输入和回查，改变了个人如何组织操作，取中档。仍以原会话产物验收，交付增量有限；使用范围限于能加载该 Web 插件的人。[Q04](#research-q04) 的时间收益只可由减少重复复制推断，核验成本仍在。

recommendation.reason: 需要重复提示的 DSH Web 用户可以在单标签和隔离工作区手动运行一项只读任务。与手动粘贴并另记链接相比，它把提示和执行会话记在同一张卡上。如果工作区、历史结果或任务状态无法核实，就停用调度并回宿主会话检查。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 execution.ts:104-131 追到明确用户、可重复任务及可确认结果，强于偶发入口便利；没有独立用户摩擦数据，未到 23。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 controller.ts:252-290 绑定运行记录和真实会话，超过快捷链接。[Q02](#research-q02) 的回读不能确认合格产物，未到实质质量已被支撑的 19。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 至 [Q03](#research-q03) 的真实宿主会话接线、调度和失败边界足够支持小规模手动只读试用，高于仅看声明；固定宿主没有执行，低于 19。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 的一次性环境及手工会话退路足以明确控制试用，超过重要风险无退路的低档；周期、持久化与回读耗时未知，未到 15。

      "content": "# dsh-task-board — DSH web GUI task board plugin\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\nA hot-pluggable DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client GUI plugin: it adds a **task board** entry below \"新会话\" (New session) in the sidebar; clicking it switches the middle column entirely to a multi-column kanban view. Tasks execute for **real** through DSH's own session mechanism (`session.prompt`), and execution status is written back to the card in real time.\n\n- No DSH source modification: mounted as a cordis plugin + browser DOM extension (add-on shape identical to `dsh-web-ui/packages/skins/skin-center`).\n- Unmounting restores the original state; other managed segments (dsh-skin / skin-center / personal config) are unaffected.\n- Task data persists locally; it survives a page refresh and a DSH restart.\n\n## Features\n\n- **Sidebar entry**: injects a \"任务看板\" (task board) entry row inside the sidebar column (`[data-pane=\"sidebar\"]` on older shells, `[class*=\"sidebarCol\"]` on the DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 AppFrame layout) below the new-session button (wide rail shows icon + text, collapsed rail shows a bare icon, adapting to DSH skin tokens).\n- **Multi-column board**: five columns — 待规划 (to plan) / 待办 (to do) / 进行中 (in progress) / 已完成 (done) / 已失败 (failed); cards show title, description, status, update time, and execution count; the top supports search filter, new task, and back to chat.\n- **Task details**: click a card to open details (title/description/execution prompt/execution log) — it does **not** execute on a single click; the details offer \"执行 / 重新执行\" (Run / Re-run), \"删除\" (Delete, with confirm), \"查看会话\" (View session, jumps to the execution transcript), and a manual move to 待规划/待办.\n- **Real execution**: on \"执行\" (Run), the plugin connects a workspace session through the client runtime (`workspaces.connectWorkspace`, reusing a blank session or letting the host create one), names the session after the task title, and drives a real agent via `session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')`; it then subscribes to that session's snapshot and, once the round really finishes, sets the card to 已完成/已失败 and records the execution result. The execution session appears in the session list and can be opened to view the real transcript.\n- **Status write-back**: card status (进行中 → 完成/失败) is driven by the real session state; after a page refresh/restart, leftover running tasks are auto-reconciled against the current session state (reconcile).\n- **Scheduled tasks**: the details panel can schedule a task — an enable switch + a 5-field cron expression (分 时 日 月 周, supporting `*` / `*/n` / `a-b` / comma lists) + common presets (daily 09:00, every hour, every 10 minutes, Mondays 09:00); enabling computes and persists the \"下次运行时间\" (next run time), and the card shows a scheduled marker; at the due time it automatically takes the same real-execution path (as manual run), and the execution session remains linkable.\n- **System-prompt injection**: the host half (`src/index.ts`) registers a `plugin:task-board` section (order 200) via `SystemPrompt.section`, declaring this plugin's existence, capabilities, and limits to every agent — it is injected when the plugin is in the composition (after mount + DSH restart) and disappears when removed (after unmount + restart), so an agent needs no external docs to know how to work with this board.\n\n## Directory structure\n\n```\npackage.json / tsconfig.json / tsdown.config.ts   # standalone repo build\nbuild/tsdown.client.ts + build/web/src/platform.ts # client bundle preset copied from the DSH checkout (kept in sync with the running version)\nsrc/index.ts / src/invariant.ts                    # host half: only injects SystemPrompt section (no other behavior)\nsrc/client/index.ts                                # apply(ctx): wires runtime services + mounts DOM\nsrc/client/sidebar-entry.ts                        # sidebar entry injection (self-healing MutationObserver)\nsrc/client/board-mount.tsx                         # middle-column board mount + show/hide toggle\nsrc/client/board/*.tsx                             # React board views (columns/cards/details/new/confirm)\nsrc/client/board.module.css                        # styles (--dsw-* tokens, adapting to theme/skin)\nsrc/core/tasks.ts                                  # task model + state machine (pure functions)\nsrc/core/schedule.ts                               # cron parsing + next-run time (pure functions)\nsrc/core/scheduler.ts                              # browser scheduler (ticks every minute to fire due tasks)\nsrc/core/store.ts                                  # persistence (TaskStore interface + localStorage impl)\nsrc/core/execution.ts                              # real execution service (session connect/prompt/settlement watch)\nsrc/core/controller.ts                             # controller (ledger state, view state, navigation awareness)\ntests/*.spec.ts                                    # automated tests: storage/state transitions/execution trigger/cron/scheduling\nscripts/dsh-task-board.js                          # one-click mount/unmount/status CLI\n```\n\n## Why it is wired this way (research conclusions)\n\n- **No usable add-on slot in the sidebar**: the sidebar shell only declares two single slots, `sidebar.workspaces` / `sidebar.settings`, both already taken by ui-workspace / ui-settings; an external plugin cannot register a new slot (declaring means claiming, and duplicating throws). So the entry goes through the skin-precedent **DOM injection**, self-healed with a MutationObserver (when a React re-render touches the node it re-inserts within the same frame, no flicker).\n- **The middle column cannot be replaced through a slot**: the `conversation` slot is single and already taken by ui-conversation. The board view mounts on the center column (`[data-pane=\"conversation\"]` on older shells, `[class*=\"centerCol\"]` on the DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 AppFrame layout) as a tail child node (outside React's ownership), toggled via the `<html data-dsh-taskboard-active>` attribute, keeping the chat subtree below mounted and stateful.\n- **Persistence uses browser localStorage**: client plugins run in the browser and DSH has no browser-writable file channel (matching skin-center's research on `cordis.patch.yml`); localStorage is also how DSH's own client snapshot store (`createSnapshotStore` persist) persists.\n- **Execution rides the client runtime**: `ctx.sessions.list` subscribes to session state (`running` / `byId`), `ctx.workspaces.connectWorkspace()` creates/reuses a session, `session.prompt()` drives a real agent, and `ctx.sessions.open()` jumps to the transcript.\n- **Background settlement relies on list reconciliation**: an unopened session has no chat-snapshot window (cold), so settlement keys off the session list — every list change reconciles running tasks; result judgment takes, in order, \"missing from list → cancelled / still running → wait / chat snapshot visible → by lastAgentError / tail of raw history → a turn-error node proves failure / otherwise success\", and reconciliation is idempotent.\n- **Scheduled tasks run in the browser scheduler**: the plugin is pure-client (no server channel), so \"run at the due time\" is done by the in-tab scheduler — a tick every minute, with an immediate catch-up tick when the page returns from the background; before firing it first moves \"next run\" forward to the next cron match so the same tick never fires twice; it does not fire early in page load (before the session-list baseline is ready), avoiding mis-execution. Limitation: the tab must stay open (schedules missed while closed are \"miss = skip\", and only already-deferred due tasks are caught up on the next open); a task that is 进行中 (in progress) skips the current due time and waits for the next cron match.\n- **Same-origin tabs share one ledger**: additions, edits, and deletions in any tab propagate to the others through storage events (`LocalStorageTaskStore.subscribeExternal`), so a task deleted in one tab can never keep firing from another tab's stale in-memory copy — nor be written back by that copy's later persistence (schedule roll-forward, execution settlement).\n\n## Install\n\nInstall the family aggregate package `@linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all` (all plugins and skins in one) or this plugin alone:\n\n```sh\n### 从 npm 安装（推荐）\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board\n\n### 从仓库安装（开发调试）\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui.git\ncd dsh-web-ui\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-task-board\n\n```\n\nAfter installing, **restart `dsh web`** — a \"任务看板\" (task board) entry appears below \"新会话\" (New session) in the sidebar; a page refresh is not enough, the process must restart.\n\n## Build\n\nPrerequisites: Node ≥ 20 with the official NPM SDK reachable (configure the `NPM_TOKEN` env var + project `.npmrc` if still using private-scope auth; see the repo `docs/plugins.md`). Types and runtime APIs all come from the official NPM SDK (`@deepseek-ai/*` devDependencies); **no DSH source checkout is required**.\n\n```sh\ncd ~/code/dsh-web-ui/packages/dsh-task-board\npnpm install        # first time (run pnpm install at the workspace root)\npnpm run build      # produces lib/index.js + lib/client.js (tsdown + shared/tsdown.client.ts preset)\npnpm run typecheck  # type check (SDK package types from node_modules)\npnpm test           # vitest: storage read/write / state transitions / execution trigger\n```\n\n## Mount / Unmount\n\nThis plugin uses the official profile-bundle shape (package.json declares `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`, see `cordis.patch.yml`). Mounting = registering the dependency and bundle rows in the web profile manifest (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`) and installing:\n\n```sh\n# Mount (registers dependencies + dsh.profile.bundles, pnpm install; takes effect after restarting the GUI)\nnode scripts/dsh-task-board.js mount\n\n# View status\nnode scripts/dsh-task-board.js status\n\n# Unmount (removes the registered rows; restores the original GUI after restart; task data is kept)\nnode scripts/dsh-task-board.js unmount\n```\n\nThe rows registered in the profile manifest:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"dependencies\": { \"@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board\": \"link:/Users/zcl/code/dsh-web-ui/packages/dsh-task-board\" },\n  \"dsh\": { \"profile\": { \"bundles\": [ \"...\", \"@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board\" ] } }\n}\n```\n\n> Note: the profile layer (bundle rows, `dsh.client` metadata) is read when the dsh web process starts, so a **restart of the dsh web GUI** is required after mount/unmount (a page refresh is not enough).\n\n## Data storage location\n\n- The task ledger lives in browser localStorage under the key `dsh.taskBoard.v1` (origin `http://127.0.0.1:<dsh web port>`; same origin persists across refresh/restart).\n- Data is retained after unmount; to clear it, run `localStorage.removeItem(\"dsh.taskBoard.v1\")` in the browser console.\n- The storage layer is the `TaskStore` interface (`src/core/store.ts`); it can later be swapped for IndexedDB or a host file channel without touching the upper logic.\n\n## Manual verification steps\n\n1. `npm run build` → `node scripts/dsh-task-board.js mount` → refresh `http://127.0.0.1:3080`.\n2. A \"任务看板\" (task board) entry row appears below \"新会话\" in the sidebar; click it → the middle column switches to the five-column board.\n3. \"+ 新建任务\" (New task) with title/description/Prompt → the card appears in 待办 (to do).\n4. Click the card → details show content and Prompt; click \"执行\" (Run) → the card becomes 进行中 (in progress) (a session named after the task title appears in the session list); after the agent finishes the card lands in 已完成 (done) or 已失败 (failed), the detail execution log has a result and time, and \"查看会话\" (View session) jumps to the real transcript.\n5. Scheduled task: details → tick \"定时运行\" (Scheduled run) to enable, pick the preset \"每 10 分钟\" (every 10 minutes, cron `*/10 * * * *`); a scheduled marker appears on the card; wait for the next whole 10-minute mark, watch the card automatically enter 进行中 (in progress) and eventually complete, with \"上次触发\" (last trigger) showing a time and a new execution-log row (the session is linkable).\n6. Refresh the page / restart DSH → tasks remain; unmount the plugin → the GUI restores to its original state.\n\n## Acceptance checklist\n\n- After mount, a \"任务看板\" (task board) entry appears in the sidebar; clicking toggles the board, and clicking a session item returns to the chat view\n- New task (title + description/Prompt); tasks remain after refresh/restart (localStorage persistence)\n- Click a card to open details (content + execution log); the details have \"执行\" (Run) and \"删除\" (Delete) buttons\n- Execution really starts a session (its transcript is visible in the session list); card status follows the real execution progress; the details can jump to the execution session\n- Delete has a confirm step, and the local store is synced-removed after deletion\n- Scheduled tasks: cron config/preset/validation, next-run time, auto real execution at the due time, status write-back, scheduled card marker, scheduling resumes after refresh (browser-side scheduling, the tab must stay open)\n- One-click mount/unmount; after unmount the GUI restores and other managed segments are unaffected\n- README + automated tests covering storage read/write, state transitions, execution trigger, cron parsing, and the scheduler\n"

      "content": "# dsh-web-ui · DSH Web UI\n\n中文 | [English](README.en.md)\n\n![dsh-web-ui](docs/dsh-web-ui-banner.png)\n\ndsh-web-ui 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 的插件与皮肤集合：任务看板、Git 图谱、右侧面板、移动端远程、远程连接、图像理解工具、鲸鱼娘宠物、实时令牌统计，以及皮肤中心。所有插件既可独立安装，也可通过聚合包一次装齐。\n\n![DSH Web UI 主界面](docs/screenshots/13-hero-main.png)\n\n## 功能插件\n\n### 任务看板\n\n在侧边栏点击「任务看板」进入。任务按五列状态组织：待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败。点击卡片上的「执行」，任务将由真实的 DSH 智能体会话执行，完成后状态自动回写；需要复盘时，可直接跳转到执行会话查看完整过程。\n\n任务支持定时执行：在详情中配置 cron 表达式（如每天 23:00 自动升级 DSH、每周一 09:00 生成周报），到点自动开工，无需人工值守。\n\n| 多列看板 | 定时执行 |\n| --- | --- |\n| ![任务看板](docs/screenshots/09-task-board.png) | ![任务定时执行](docs/screenshots/10-task-board-detail-cron.png) |\n\n### Git 图谱\n\n输入框上方的分支选择器，支持切换分支与查看提交历史；Git 图谱将分支泳道与提交历史可视化，仓库再大也能顺着时间线快速定位变更。\n\n![Git 图谱](docs/screenshots/04-git-graph.png)\n\n### 右侧面板\n\n项目会话打开时，聊天区右侧出现「预览」与「文件/变更」两块面板：\n\n- **文件树**：浏览工作目录，点击文件即在预览面板打开，整行点击展开文件夹，支持按文件名搜索定位；\n- **预览**：多标签预览 markdown、HTML、代码、diff、CSV、PDF、Office、图片与文本等格式，支持源码 / 预览切换、分屏编辑与保存；\n- **变更（SCM）**：真实 git 变更面板，支持 stage / unstage / discard；\n- 面板宽度可拖拽调整，双击把手复位默认宽度，折叠状态与宽度按项目持久化；\n- 10 款皮肤全部适配右侧面板，换肤后面板随之融入主题。\n\n![右侧面板](docs/screenshots/19-right-panel.png)\n\n### 鲸鱼娘宠物\n\n一只常驻界面的鲸鱼娘宠物，会跟随智能体的状态切换动画：思考、等待、工作、庆祝。点击可互动（摸头），投喂小鱼干可提升亲密度，陪伴度从幼鲸一路成长至「深海羁绊」。支持自定义名称、自由拖动位置，也可随时隐藏。\n\n| 陪伴工作 | 互动面板 |\n| --- | --- |\n| ![鲸鱼娘宠物](docs/screenshots/11-pet-new-chat.png) | ![宠物互动面板](docs/screenshots/12-pet-panel.png) |\n\n### 实时令牌统计\n\n在输入框下方实时显示生成速度（TPS）、LLM 耗时、上下文占用、缓存命中率以及输入 / 输出 token 数，每次生成的用量一目了然。\n\n![实时令牌统计](docs/screenshots/18-live-stats.png)\n\n### 移动端远程\n\n侧边栏底部的手机图标打开配对面板：扫码配对（或复制链接）后，手机进入独立的移动端界面，远程控制当前 dsh web 工作区——查看与新建会话、收发消息、切换模型与思考强度、调整权限预设，全部与桌面端同步。配对令牌一次性且限时，「停止」可随时吊销所有设备；二维码默认走局域网，也可开启 cloudflared 公网隧道，让手机在任意网络配对。\n\n> **实时消息与隧道**：移动端依赖 SSE（Server-Sent Events）实时接收消息。Cloudflare quick the controller\n * owns only the orchestration seam (state, persistence, notify, execution,\n * navigation, reconciliation).\n */\nimport { ExecutionService, type ExecutionEvent } from './execution.ts'\nimport type { TaskStore } from './store.ts'\nimport {\n  settleExecution, startExecution, withStatus,\n  type NewTaskInput, type TaskRecord, type TaskStatus,\n} from './tasks.ts'\nimport { applyCreateTask } from './use-cases/task-create.ts'\nimport { applyDeleteTask } from './use-cases/task-delete.ts'\nimport { applyScheduleNextRun as applyScheduleRollForward, applySetSchedule } from './use-cases/task-schedule.ts'\nimport { applyUpdateTask } from './use-cases/task-update.ts'\n\n/** The sessions face the controller needs for navigation awareness. */\nexport interface SessionsControllerFace {\n  list: {\n    getSnapshot(): { current: string | undefined }\n    subscribe(fn: () => void): () => void\n  }\n  /** Select a session as current (navigates the conversation view). */\n  open(id: string): void\n}\n\n/** Controller dependencies (all swappable in tests). */\nexport interface ControllerDeps {\n  store: TaskStore\n  exec: ExecutionService\n  sessions: SessionsControllerFace\n  /** Clock; this.listeners.add(fn)\n    return () => { this.listeners.delete(fn) }\n  }\n\n  // --- view state -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  openBoard(): void {\n    if 350)\n  }\n\n  /** Settle tasks left 'running' whose sessions already finished. */\n  private async reconcileRunningTasks(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.reconcileInFlight) return\n    this.reconcileInFlight = true\n    try {\n      type Settled = Extract<ExecutionEvent, { kind: 'settled' }>\n      const events: Array<{ taskId: string; event: Settled }> = []\n      for (const task of this.tasks) {\n        if (task.status !== 'running') continue\n        const execution = task.executions[task.executions.length - 1]\n        // Runs launched on this page settle through their live watch (turn\n        // boundary); reconciliation exists for background/leftover runs.\n        if (execution !== undefined && this.activeExecutionIds.has(execution.id)) continue\n        const event = await this.deps.exec.reconcile(task)\n        if (event !== undefined && event.kind === 'settled') events.push({ taskId: task.id, event })\n      }\n      if (events.length === 0) return\n      let changed = false\n      for (const { taskId, event } of events) {\n        // The reconcile call above awaited: a sibling tab may have rewritten\n        // the ledger (storage event reload) meanwhile. './tasks.ts'\n\n/** The narrow sessions face the service needs. */\nexport interface SessionsExecutionFace {\n  list: {\n    getSnapshot(): {\n      /** Baseline arrival lifecycle — 'pending' until }).reason\n  return typeof reason === 'object' && reason !== null\n    && (reason as { kind?: unknown }).kind === 'error'\n}\n\n/**\n * Run one task to completion (or to a settled failure).\n *\n * fake). */\n  constructor(private readonly env: ExecutionEnvironment) {}\n\n  async run(\n    task: TaskRecord,\n    execution: ExecutionRecord,\n    onEvent: (event: ExecutionEvent) => void,\n  ):       "content": "/**\n * Browser-side scheduler: the heartbeat behind scheduled task runs.\n *\n * The board is a pure client plugin with no server channel, so \"定时任务\"\n * lives in the tab: a timer ticks every minute (plus immediately on tab\n * visibility recovery) and triggers any task whose `schedule.nextRunAt` is\n * due, rolling the schedule forward to the next cron match before triggering\n * so the same tick never double-fires. Missed runs are skipped, never queued:\n * a task still running at its due instant is skipped by the controller's\n * runTask guard and simply waits for the next cron match.\n *\n * The ticker is controlled: `start` arms a single interval guarded by an\n * idempotence check (a second start while running is a no-op, so wiring can\n * never leak a duplicate timer), and `stop`/`dispose` clear the timer and\n * drop the environment listeners. The board unmount path calls stop/dispose,\n * so no interval or listener outlives the board.\n *\n * Framework-free: all runtime access flows through the injected deps\n * (structural faces), so tests drive ticks directly without timers.\n */\nimport { nextRunAtMs } from './schedule.ts'\nimport type { TaskRecord } from './tasks.ts'\n\n/** Everything the scheduler needs from its host (the board controller). */\nexport interface SchedulerDeps {\n  /** Read the current task ledger (the controller snapshot). */\n  tasks(): readonly TaskRecord[]\n  /** Clock; defaults to Date.now in the controller wiring. */\n  now(): number\n  /** Trigger one task's real execution (the controller's runTask); resolves\n   *  true when the run was accepted, false when rejected (e.g. the task is\n   *  already running). */\n  runTask(id: string): Promise<boolean>\n  /** Persist a rolled-forward schedule (next due + this trigger instant). */\n  applySchedule(id: string, nextRunAt: number | undefined, lastTriggeredAt: number | undefined): void\n  /** Tick cadence; defaults to 60_000 ms. */\n  tickMs?: number\n  /**\n   * Gate: while false the tick no-ops (e.g. the session list baseline has not\n   * arrived on page load, so executions would fail). Defaults to always ready.\n   */\n  ready?: () => boolean\n  /** Environment listeners for tab-visibility recovery (browser only). */\n  environment?: {\n    addEventListener(type: 'visibilitychange', listener: () => void): void\n    removeEventListener(type: 'visibilitychange', listener: () => void): void\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The schedule heartbeat (see module doc). `tick` is public so tests and\n * callers can drive a check without waiting for the interval.\n */\nexport class SchedulerService {\n  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined\n  private environmentListener: (() => void) | undefined\n  private disposed = false\n  private started = false\n\n  /** @param deps - tasks/clock/trigger/apply faces (see {@link SchedulerDeps}). */\n  constructor(private readonly deps: SchedulerDeps) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Start ticking: one immediate check (catch-up after reload) + the interval.\n   * Single-instance: a second start while already armed is a no-op, so a\n   * re-entrant mount can never stack a duplicate timer.\n   */\n  start(): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    if (this.started) return\n    this.started = true\n    // Immediate catch-up tick: schedules whose due instant passed while the\n    // tab was closed are triggered as soon as the runtime is ready.\n    this.tick()\n    this.timer = setInterval(() => { this.tick() }, this.deps.tickMs ?? 60_000)\n    if (this.deps.environment !== undefined) {\n      this.environmentListener = () => { this.tick() }\n      this.deps.environment.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.environmentListener)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Stop ticking and drop listeners (idempotent). Preferred shutdown verb for\n   * callers that treat the scheduler as a controlled ticker; `dispose` is an\n   * alias.\n   */\n  stop(): void {\n    this.dispose()\n  }\n\n  /** Stop ticking and drop listeners (idempotent). */\n  dispose(): void {\n    if (this.disposed && this.timer === undefined && this.environmentListener === undefined) return\n    this.disposed = true\n    this.started = false\n    if (this.timer !== undefined) {\n      clearInterval(this.timer)\n      this.timer = undefined\n    }\n    if (this.environmentListener !== undefined && this.deps.environment !== undefined) {\n      this.deps.environment.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.environmentListener)\n      this.environmentListener = undefined\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check every enabled schedule and trigger the due ones. Idempotent per\n   * task per tick: the schedule is rolled forward only after runTask accepts\n   * the run, so a rejected run keeps its due slot and is retried on the next\n   * tick instead of being silently dropped.\n   */\n  async tick(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    if (this.deps.ready !== undefined && !this.deps.ready()) return\n    const now = this.deps.now()\n    for (const task of this.deps.tasks()) {\n      const schedule = task.schedule\n      if (schedule === undefined || !schedule.enabled) continue\n      if (schedule.nextRunAt === undefined) {\n        // Missing next-run instant (repaired/legacy data): recompute from the\n        // cron expression and wait; an unparseable expression is skipped.\n        const repaired = nextRunAtMs(schedule.cron, now)\n        if (repaired === undefined) continue\n        this.deps.applySchedule(task.id, repaired, undefined)\n        continue\n      }\n      if (schedule.nextRunAt > now) continue\n      // Advance from the due instant (not this tick's wall-clock) and only\n      // after the run is accepted: a rejected run keeps its due slot.\n      const next = nextRunAtMs(schedule.cron, schedule.nextRunAt)\n      const accepted = await this.deps.runTask(task.id)\n      if (accepted) this.deps.applySchedule(task.id, next, now)\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Task persistence: a small storage seam with a localStorage backend.\n *\n * The task-board client plugin runs in the browser, and dsh exposes no\n * browser-writable file channel (same conclusion the skin-center research\n * reached for cordis.patch.yml), so tasks persist in the browser's\n * localStorage under a versioned key — the same persistence mechanism dsh's\n * own client snapshot stores use (`createSnapshotStore` persist). Data\n * survives page refreshes and dsh restarts (same origin), and survives\n * plugin uninstall (the key is simply left in place).\n *\n * The seam keeps the backend swappable (e.g. an IndexedDB or a host-file\n * channel later); tests run against the in-memory backend and a jsdom\n * localStorage backend.\n */\nimport { isValidCron } from './schedule.ts'\nimport type { ScheduleRule, TaskRecord, TaskStatus } from './tasks.ts'\nimport { isTaskStatus } from './tasks.ts'\n\n/** Persistence seam for the task ledger. */\nexport interface TaskStore {\n  /** Read the persisted ledger (empty when nothing is stored yet). */\n  load(): TaskRecord[]\n  /** Persist the whole ledger (replaces the stored document). */\n  save(tasks: readonly TaskRecord[]): void\n  /** Drop the persisted ledger (leaves the in-memory state alone). */\n  clear(): void\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to ledger changes written by ANOTHER tab of the same origin\n   * (browser storage events). The board controller reloads the ledger on\n   * such a change, so a task deleted in one tab cannot keep firing (or be\n   * written back) from the stale in-memory copy of another tab. No-op when\n   * the backend has no cross-instance channel (in-memory store).\n   */\n  subscribeExternal?(listener: () => void): () => void\n}\n\n/** Storage key for the task ledger document. */\nexport const DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY = 'dsh.taskBoard.v1'\n\n/** Structural shape of the storage event fired in sibling tabs (DOM-free). */\nexport interface StorageChangeEvent {\n  key: string | null\n}\n\n/** The event-target face the store needs for cross-tab notifications. */\nexport interface StorageEvents {\n  addEventListener(type: 'storage', listener: (event: StorageChangeEvent) => void): void\n  removeEventListener(type: 'storage', listener: (event: StorageChangeEvent) => void): void\n}\n\n/**\n * Structural row check with the status left unvalidated (see {@link parseLedger}).\n * The `schedule` field is deliberately NOT checked here: a malformed schedule\n * never drops the task row — {@link normalizeSchedule} repairs or drops the\n * schedule alone.\n */\nfunction isTaskRecordShape(value: unknown): value is Omit<TaskRecord, 'status'> & { status: unknown } {\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false\n  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>\n  if (typeof record.id !== 'string' || record.id === '') return false\n  if (typeof record.title !== 'string') return false\n  if (typeof record.description !== 'string') return false\n  if (typeof record.prompt !== 'string') return false\n  if (typeof record.createdAt !== 'number') return false\n  if (typeof record.updatedAt !== 'number') return false\n  if (!Array.isArray(record.executions)) return false\n  for (const execution of record.executions) {\n    if (typeof execution !== 'object' || execution === null) return false\n    const entry = execution as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (typeof entry.id !== 'string') return false\n    if (entry.sessionId !== undefined && typeof entry.sessionId !== 'string') return false\n    if (typeof entry.startedAt !== 'number') return false\n    if (entry.endedAt !== undefined && typeof entry.endedAt !== 'number') return false\n    if (entry.result !== undefined && entry.result !== 'succeeded' && entry.result !== 'failed' && entry.result !== 'cancelled') return false\n    if (entry.error !== undefined && typeof entry.error !== 'string') return false\n  }\n  return true\n}\n\n/** A task record is structurally valid if it round-trips through the UI. */\nexport function isTaskRecord(value: unknown): value is TaskRecord {\n  return isTaskRecordShape(value) && isTaskStatus(value.status)\n}\n\n/** Normalize an unknown persisted status back into the closed status union. */\nfunction normalizeStatus(status: unknown): TaskStatus {\n  return isTaskStatus(status) ? status : 'todo'\n}\n\n/**\n * Repair a persisted schedule rule: drop rules without a usable cron string,\n * coerce booleans/numbers, and leave `nextRunAt`/`lastTriggeredAt` undefined\n * when missing (a fresh recompute or the next tick fixes them).\n */\nfunction normalizeSchedule(schedule: unknown): ScheduleRule | undefined {\n  if (typeof schedule !== 'object' || schedule === null) return undefined\n  const rule = schedule as Record<string, unknown>\n  // Reject (drop) a schedule whose cron is not a well-formed 5-field\n  // expression: a malformed rule would otherwise linger as a never-firing\n  // schedule instead of being dropped for later repair.\n  if (typeof rule.cron !== 'string') return undefined\n  if (rule.cron.trim() === '' || !isValidCron(rule.cron)) return undefined\n  return {\n    enabled: rule.enabled === true,\n    cron: rule.cron,\n    nextRunAt: typeof rule.nextRunAt === 'number' ? rule.nextRunAt : undefined,\n    lastTriggeredAt: typeof rule.lastTriggeredAt === 'number' ? rule.lastTriggeredAt : undefined,\n  }\n}\n\n/** Parse + validate a persisted ledger document; invalid rows are dropped. */\nexport function parseLedger(raw: string | null): TaskRecord[] {\n  if (raw === null) return []\n  let parsed: unknown\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(raw)\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('[dsh-task-board] persisted task ledger is not valid JSON; starting empty', error)\n    return []\n  }\n  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n    console.error('[dsh-task-board] persisted task ledger is not an array; starting empty')\n    return []\n  }\n  const tasks: TaskRecord[] = []\n  for (const row of parsed) {\n    // Status is normalized (an unknown status from a future version lands in\n    // todo instead of dropping the row); the schedule is repaired field by\n    // field; every other field must be valid.\n    if (!isTaskRecordShape(row)) {\n      console.warn('[dsh-task-board] dropping invalid task row from persisted ledger', row)\n      continue\n    }\n    // Always (re)assign the schedule: a repair that returns undefined must\n    // clear a malformed persisted rule rather than leave it in the row.\n    const task: TaskRecord = { ...row, status: normalizeStatus(row.status) }\n    task.schedule = normalizeSchedule(row.schedule)\n    tasks.push(task)\n  }\n  return tasks\n}\n\n/** localStorage-backed store (the browser backend). */\nexport class LocalStorageTaskStore implements TaskStore {\n  /**\n   * @param key - storage key for the ledger document.\n   * @param storage - storage backend (defaults to the global localStorage; tests inject fakes).\n   * @param events - storage-event target for cross-tab notifications (defaults\n   *   to the browser global; undefined in non-browser runtimes, where the\n   *   subscription becomes a no-op).\n   */\n  constructor(\n    private readonly key: string = DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY,\n    private readonly storage: Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem' | 'removeItem'> | undefined = globalThis.localStorage,\n    private readonly events: StorageEvents | undefined = typeof (globalThis as { addEventListener?: unknown }).addEventListener === 'function'\n      ? (globalThis as unknown as StorageEvents)\n      : undefined,\n  ) {}\n\n  load(): TaskRecord[] {\n    if (this.storage === undefined) return []\n    try {\n      return parseLedger(this.storage.getItem(this.key))\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Storage read failures (private mode, quota) degrade to an empty ledger,\n      // never break the board.\n      console.error('[dsh-task-board] task ledger read failed; starting empty', error)\n      return []\n    }\n  }\n\n  save(tasks: readonly TaskRecord[]): void {\n    if (this.storage === undefined) return\n    try {\n      this.storage.setItem(this.key, JSON.stringify(tasks))\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Write failures only skip persistence; in-memory state stays live.\n      console.error('[dsh-task-board] task ledger write failed (persistence skipped)', error)\n    }\n  }\n\n  clear(): void {\n    if (this.storage === undefined) return\n    try {\n      this.storage.removeItem(this.key)\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[dsh-task-board] task ledger clear failed', error)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Cross-tab change subscription (see {@link TaskStore.subscribeExternal}).\n   * The browser fires the storage event in every OTHER tab of the same origin\n   * when one tab writes; a null key means the whole storage was cleared. Both\n   * cases reload the ledger here; unrelated keys are ignored.\n   */\n  subscribeExternal(listener: () => void): () => void {\n    if (this.events === undefined) return () => {}\n    const onStorage = (event: StorageChangeEvent): void => {\n      if (event.key !== null && event.key !== this.key) return\n      listener()\n    }\n    this.events.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)\n    return () => { this.events?.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage) }\n  }\n}\n\n/** In-memory backend (tests, and a fallback when storage is unavailable). */\nexport class InMemoryTaskStore implements TaskStore {\n  private ledger: TaskRecord[] = []\n\n  load(): TaskRecord[] {\n    return this.ledger.map(task => ({ ...task, executions: [...task.executions] }))\n  }\n\n  save(tasks: readonly TaskRecord[]): void {\n    this.ledger = tasks.map(task => ({ ...task, executions: [...task.executions] }))\n  }\n\n  clear(): void {\n    this.ledger = []\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Board view mounting.\n *\n * The `conversation` slot is single-occupant (ui-conversation) and external\n * plugins cannot declare slots, so the board takes over the center column at\n * the DOM level: a container is appended inside the center column\n * (`[class*=\"centerCol\"]`, the dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 AppFrame layout; previously\n * `[data-pane=\"conversation\"]` on older shells — the mount selector keeps both)\n * as an extra trailing child\n * React never manages, and a stylesheet\n * rule hides the conversation content while the board is active. Toggling is\n * a data attribute on <html> — no React involvement, so the conversation\n * subtree underneath stays mounted and stateful.\n */\nimport { createRoot, type Root } from 'react-dom/client'\nimport type { BoardController } from '../core/controller.ts'\nimport { TaskBoard } from './board/TaskBoard.tsx'\nimport css from './board.module.css'\n\n/** The injected board container (kept in the DOM, hidden when inactive). */\nexport const BOARD_VIEW_SELECTOR = '[data-dsh-taskboard-view]'\n\nconst CONVERSATION_COLUMN_SELECTOR = '[data-pane=\"conversation\"], [class*=\"centerCol\"]'\nconst ACTIVE_ATTR = 'data-dsh-taskboard-active'\n/** The sibling panel's activation attribute (ssh), removed when this panel opens. */\nconst OTHER_ACTIVE_ATTR = 'data-dsh-ssh-active'\n/** Cross-plugin activation event; detail is the activating panel name. */\nconst ACTIVATE_EVENT = 'dsh-panel-activate'\nconst PANEL_NAME = 'taskboard'\n\n/** Find the center column, or undefined while the frame is not mounted. */\nfunction conversationColumn(): HTMLElement | undefined {\n  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(CONVERSATION_COLUMN_SELECTOR) ?? undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Mount the board React tree into the center column and bind its visibility\n * to the controller's boardOpen state.\n * @param controller - the board controller driving the view.\n * @returns disposer unmounting the tree and restoring the column.\n */\nexport function mountBoard(controller: BoardController): () => void {\n  let root: Root | undefined\n  let container: HTMLDivElement | undefined\n\n  const ensure = (): void => {\n    if (container !== undefined) return\n    const column = conversationColumn()\n    if (column === undefined) return\n    container = document.createElement('div')\n    container.dataset.dshTaskboardView = ''\n    container.className = css.boardView\n    column.appendChild(container)\n    root = createRoot(container)\n    root.render(<TaskBoard controller={controller} />)\n  }\n\n  // The frame mounts after boot settlement; watch for the column's arrival.\n  const waitObserver = new MutationObserver(() => { ensure() })\n  waitObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true })\n\n  const applyActive = (): void => {\n    if (controller.getSnapshot().boardOpen) {\n      // Single-occupant center column: opening this panel must evict the\n      // sibling panel (ssh), both its html attribute and its controller\n      // state, otherwise the two panels' visibility rules fight and the\n      // second click appears dead.\n      document.documentElement.removeAttribute(OTHER_ACTIVE_ATTR)\n      document.documentElement.setAttribute(ACTIVE_ATTR, '')\n      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(ACTIVATE_EVENT, { detail: PANEL_NAME }))\n    } else {\n      document.documentElement.removeAttribute(ACTIVE_ATTR)\n    }\n  }\n  const onOtherActivate = (event: Event): void => {\n    if ((event as CustomEvent).detail === 'ssh' && controller.getSnapshot().boardOpen) {\n      controller.closeBoard()\n    }\n  }\n  // Jump out on sidebar context clicks: clicking a session/workspace row\n  // (including the already-current one, which produces no session-change\n  // event) hands the center column back to the conversation. Capture phase,\n  // so the panel closes before the shell processes the click.\n  const SIDEBAR_ROW_SELECTOR = '[class*=\"sessionRow\"], [class*=\"projectRow\"], [class*=\"searchResultRow\"], [class*=\"searchResultWorkspace\"], [class*=\"newSession\"]'\n  const onClickSidebarRow = (event: MouseEvent): void => {\n    if (!controller.getSnapshot().boardOpen) return\n    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null\n    if (target === null) return\n    if (target.closest(SIDEBAR_ROW_SELECTOR) !== null) controller.closeBoard()\n  }\n  document.addEventListener('click', onClickSidebarRow, true)\n  document.addEventListener(ACTIVATE_EVENT, onOtherActivate)\n  const unsubscribe = controller.subscribe(applyActive)\n  applyActive()\n  ensure()\n\n  return () => {\n    document.removeEventListener('click', onClickSidebarRow, true)\n    document.removeEventListener(ACTIVATE_EVENT, onOtherActivate)\n    waitObserver.disconnect()\n    unsubscribe()\n    document.documentElement.removeAttribute(ACTIVE_ATTR)\n    root?.unmount()\n    root = undefined\n    container?.remove()\n    container = undefined\n  }\n}\n"
